snippet.title: God of War Laufey - Meet the Cast | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Wishlist God of War Laufey now at https://www.playstation.com/games/god-of-war-laufey.  

Leading our cast of incredible performers in God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll reprises her role as the legendary warrior Faye (Laufey) alongside Jack Quaid (Phranque) and Perlina Lau (Rue)!  

Launches on PlayStation 5 February 16, 2027.
